messages:
Iris Park: noticed a persistent tiny leak where invoice-preview shows fewer tokens than metering.emitted for a handful of routes using the new route-resolver caching. Delta ~0.3% across last 48h. Logs show requests reach proxy but enrichment sometimes emits after the metering write so preview excludes them.

Noah Feldman: can you paste the minimal repro? which routes/tenants?

Iris Park: sample tenant: na-221, route=res-sla-2. Query: 
``
select count(*) from metering.emitted where route='res-sla-2' and ts > now()- interval '48 hours';
select count(*) from preview.events where route='res-sla-2' and ts > now()- interval '48 hours';
```
emitted=3,112,455 preview=3,101,900.

Sofia Martinez: sounds like emission before enrichment race. We intentionally emit early to keep latency low; enrichment patches attributes asynchronously. Preview currently only counts enriched events. Two options: (A) change preview to count best-effort events and mark them provisional, (B) change ingest to delay emit until enrichment completes for routes marked SLA-critical.

Iris Park: (A) is lower risk and gives observability. (B) would increase p99 and Dedicated customers might object.

Noah Feldman: agree (A). Proposal: add "provisional" flag on emitted events when route metadata not final. Preview shows provisional_count and committed_count side-by-side. Add alert if provisional_fraction > 10% for 30m. Also add metric plat.ingest.provisional_emits per-route.

DevOps-bot: alert: provisional_emit_fraction > 10% for route=res-sla-2 tenant=na-221 window=2026-03-22T02:00-02:30Z. Ticket PLAT-6210 opened.

Sofia Martinez: I'll add the provisional flag and metric behind a feature flag. We'll canary for 1% traffic in NA. Noah can you own the preview UI change + billing copy?

Noah Feldman: yes. Billing copy draft: "Preview includes provisional events (not yet confirmed by ledger). Provisional counts are excluded from final invoices until ledger confirmation. Reconciliation expected within 24h." billing-bot, any policy issues?

billing-bot: policy: provisional tokens must not be invoiced. If provisional > 0.5% sustained for 24h, notify BillingOps automatically. File PLAT-6210 for tracking.

Iris Park: timeline: Sofia -> feature flag PR for provisional flag (WIP), Noah -> preview patch + dashboard tile, canary next Tue 08:00 UTC for 1% - increase if metrics stable.

Sofia Martinez: PR opened https://git.internal/redwood/ingest/pulls/412 (WIP)  adds provisional flag + metric behind flag.

Noah Feldman: I'll wire dashboard and alert. Thanks team. Follow-ups: Sofia PR, Noah UI + billing copy, Iris coordinate canary. :thumbsup:
